subject: Scheduled export failing with EXP-504
body: Our nightly Scheduled Exports job has timed out with error EXP-504 every night since Saturday. The CSV never lands in our S3 bucket, and the job history just shows the same timeout. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: Export to warehouse times out (EXP-504)
body: Scheduled Exports to our Snowflake warehouse fails with EXP-504 whenever the dataset is over about 2 GB. Smaller test exports go through fine. Is there a size limit we are hitting?

subject: 429s during batch sync
body: We are hitting rate limits on the REST API during our morning batch sync and getting 429 responses. What are the limits on the Enterprise plan, and is there a recommended backoff strategy?

subject: EXP-504 again, third time this week
body: We retried the export per the troubleshooting steps and it failed again with EXP-504. Our finance team is blocked on month-end reporting because the Scheduled Exports feed never arrives. This is becoming a real problem for us.

subject: Dashboard slow to load
body: Our main dashboard takes over thirty seconds to render when it has twelve widgets. Individual charts load fine on their own. Is there a widget count we should stay under?

subject: Still can't get exports out
body: Following up on my earlier ticket. Scheduled Exports still fails with EXP-504 on anything full-size, and your support engineer told us the legacy export engine is the root cause. We have a renewal decision coming up this month and I need to know if there is a fix ETA.

subject: Provisioning API keys for a new team
body: We are onboarding a new analytics team and need to provision scoped API keys for the REST API. Can key usage be traced in the audit logs? We need per-key attribution for compliance.

subject: Webhook retry behavior
body: When our endpoint is down, how many times do webhooks retry and with what backoff? Also, how do we verify webhook signatures? We want to harden our consumer before we go live with it.

subject: Export timeouts unresolved, evaluating alternatives
body: Three weeks in and Scheduled Exports still dies with EXP-504 on our nightly run. We have started evaluating alternatives because we cannot run finance on manual downloads. Escalating this before our contract conversation.

subject: SSO login loop after SAML cert rotation (SSO-301)
body: After we rotated our SAML certificate, users get bounced back to the login page in a loop with error SSO-301. Our IdP config looks correct on our side. Several hundred users are affected.

subject: Invoice shows wrong billing period
body: Our July invoice shows a billing period of June 15 to July 15, but we switched billing cycles in May and should be on calendar months. Can someone correct the billing period and reissue the invoice?

subject: Half the org still can't log in (SSO-301)
body: The SSO-301 loop is still hitting roughly half our users a week later. Adoption numbers are cratering because people simply stop trying to log in. We need someone on a call with our identity team.

subject: EXP-504 on nightly Scheduled Exports
body: Our Scheduled Exports job started failing with EXP-504 after we added last quarter's data to the workspace. It ran fine for months before that. The job seems to give up at exactly fifteen minutes.

subject: Request: admin bypass while SSO is broken
body: We are still seeing SSO-301 intermittently and two admins are fully locked out. Is there a supported way to bypass SSO for named admin accounts until the SAML issue is resolved?

subject: Upgrade path from Free to Pro
body: We are close to the row limits on the Free plan. If we upgrade to Pro mid-cycle, is billing prorated, and do our existing dashboards and API keys carry over unchanged?

subject: Export failures blocking our BI refresh
body: EXP-504 is still killing our nightly Scheduled Exports run, which means our downstream BI refresh has been stale for two weeks. The team has started doing manual pulls, which defeats the point of the product.

subject: Dashboard filters reset on share
body: When we share a dashboard link, the recipient sees default filters instead of the ones we saved. Started happening after the last release. Minor, but it confuses stakeholders.

subject: Mobile app crash on iOS 19
body: The mobile app crashes on launch for two of our field users after the iOS 19 update. Reinstalling did not help. Crash logs attached from both devices.

subject: Audit log retention window
body: Compliance is asking how long audit logs are retained on the Enterprise plan and whether the retention window can be extended to two years. Is retention configurable per workspace?

subject: Data Import column mapping question
body: In the Data Import wizard, can we save a column mapping as a template? We import the same shape of file weekly and re-mapping twenty columns by hand each time is error-prone.
